pixel_convention: x right, y DOWN (image rows); all values in pixels of the original 2560x1440 frame

camera.motion: static (cart pixels identical in frames 0 and 71 except where the lid moves; background gradient unchanged)
camera.view: side view, camera roughly at the height of the cart roof / lower drone path; grey studio backdrop with a light floor, no horizon or markings
camera.perspective_note: slight: the drone's plate is seen from above while low (frames <30) and from below when high, changing the visible top rim by ~6 px; drone apparent width constant (plate 231 px, body ~88 px) -> constant depth

objects.name: drone
objects.description: small black delivery drone: wide flat top plate with 4 motor arms and spinning white/grey propellers, a black cylindrical body hanging below; it starts docked inside the cart (only the plate visible on the roof) and flies straight up out of it
objects.visible_frames: 0-71 (body below the roof hidden in frames 0-25; fully visible 26-71)
objects.reference_point: ref_x, ref_y = centre of the drone's bounding box (plate top edge to body bottom); used as the origin

sizes_px.height_including_bright_top_rim: 195-201 (rim adds ~1 px when high, ~6 px when low)
sizes_px.propeller_span_note: props spin; span varies 290-353 px frame to frame (tips 1159-1512)

motion_summary_px.direction: vertically upward (image -y); horizontal drift < 1 px over the clip
motion_summary_px.per_frame_displacement: 7.14 px/frame upward, constant from frame 1->2 to 70->71 (linear fit rms residual 0.27 px, quadratic term ~0)

objects.name: lid
objects.description: the cart's hinged roof hatch/handle frame (black flat frame with oval cut-out), hinged on the cart roof near the left (front-slope) edge; open, tilted up-left at the start; swings over the top to the right and down while the drone leaves
objects.motion_summary: at rest at ~40.5 deg (pointing up-left) frames 0-21; rotates clockwise in the image from frame ~22; vertical (90 deg) at frame ~45; 163.8 deg (pointing up-right, nearly closed) at frame 71, still moving

objects.name: cart
objects.description: static black delivery robot / cart: rounded box body with sloped front (left) face, grey chassis strip with a slot and two round buttons, two visible white-hub wheels with black tyres

objects.name: left_wheel
objects.description: front/left visible wheel of the cart (white hub, black tyre)
objects.note: approximate; tyre outline blends with chassis at the top

objects.name: right_wheel
objects.description: rear/right visible wheel of the cart

objects.name: floor_backdrop
objects.description: seamless grey studio backdrop / light floor; no markings

events.event: drone at rest docked in cart
drone take-off (start of motion): first moved frame
events.note: last rest frame 1 (t=0.0417); moves at full constant speed immediately

events.event: drone body fully clears the cart roof (body bottom above roof y=983)
end of clip, drone still rising at constant speed, lid still closing

files.tracks/drone.csv: per-frame drone track (reference point, bbox pieces, extents, occlusion flag)
files.tracks/drone_raw.csv: integer threshold measurements the track is built from
files.tracks/lid.csv: per-frame lid tip and angle about hinge
